Context: 20. Pension through Public Sector Banks / Post Office Savings Bank

3. In case the pensioner is unable to visit the Embassy/ Consulate, he/she may submit requisite documents by post to the Embassy/ Consulate, including Doctor's Certificate showing the pensioner's inability to present himself/ herself in person. Embassy of India/ High Commission/ Indian Consulate may also assist pensioners I family pensioners in submission of the Life Certificate.
